input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Clause 2.2 imposes a sole-supplier/exclusivity obligation on Customer for hosted analytics services for the whole term, with no category limit, time limit, or performance-based exit — the playbook walk-away position. It also conflicts with clause 2.1, which states no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Preferred position is no exclusivity binding Customer, so the clause is deleted; no exclusivity benefiting Customer is affected.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the sole-and-exclusive provider commitment in clause 2.2 because our playbook does not permit exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations on us, and the clause conflicts with clause 2.1 (no minimum or purchase commitment). If Silverline needs volume assurance, we can discuss a non-exclusive statement or exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months that ends automatically on any service-level or delivery failure.
proposal.summary: Delete exclusivity obligation making Vendor Customer's sole and exclusive provider.
